R.SUBMITTED_AT IS NOT NULL AND R.REQUEST_STATUS <> 'DRAFT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS ACTOR JOIN DEPARTMENT ACTOR_DEPT ON ACTOR_DEPT.DEPT_ID = ACTOR.DEPT_ID WHERE ACTOR.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND ACTOR.ENABLED = 'Y' AND ( R.DEPT_ID = ACTOR.DEPT_ID OR ( ACTOR_DEPT.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = ACTOR.USER_ID AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ( 'DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN' ) ) ) ) )

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.IS_URGENT, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT, R.DRAFTER_ID, DRAFTER.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN ( SELECT CURRENT_APPROVAL.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM ( SELECT A.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM APPROVAL A WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND A.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID ) CURRENT_APPROVAL WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS CURRENT_APPROVAL_TYPE, CASE WHEN R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL C WHERE C.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID ) END AS SQL_COUNT, CASE WHEN R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 OR COUNT(CR.QUERY_ID) < COUNT(*) THEN 'PENDING' WHEN COUNT( CASE WHEN CR.RESULT_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END ) > 0 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN COUNT( CASE WHEN CR.RESULT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END ) = COUNT(*) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE NULL END FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL C LEFT JOIN DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT CR ON CR.QUERY_ID = C.QUERY_ID WHERE C.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID ) ELSE NULL END AS VIEW_RESULT_STATUS
WHERE
ORDER BY R.SUBMITTED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, R.IS_URGENT, R.DESIRED_DATE, DRAFTER.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT
WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, I.AUTHORING_TYPE, I.VALIDATION_STATUS, I.ITEM_CLASS
JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_ID

SELECT V.QUERY_ID, V.QUERY_ORDER, V.SQL_TITLE AS QUERY_TITLE, V.SQL_CONTENT AS SQL_TEXT, CR.RESULT_STATUS AS CHANGE_RESULT_STATUS, CR.RESULT_NOTE AS CHANGE_RESULT_NOTE, CR.EXECUTED_BY AS CHANGE_EXECUTED_BY, CR.REGISTERED_BY AS CHANGE_REGISTERED_BY, CR.REGISTERED_AT AS CHANGE_REGISTERED_AT, EXECUTOR.USER_NAME AS CHANGE_EXECUTED_BY_NAME, EXECUTOR_DEPT.DEPT_NAME AS CHANGE_EXECUTED_DEPT_NAME, REGISTRAR.USER_NAME AS CHANGE_REGISTERED_BY_NAME, REGISTRAR_DEPT.DEPT_NAME AS CHANGE_REGISTERED_DEPT_NAME FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL V JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = V.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS DRAFTER ON DRAFTER.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT REQUEST_DEPT ON REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT CR ON CR.QUERY_ID = V.QUERY_ID LEFT JOIN USERS EXECUTOR ON EXECUTOR.USER_ID = CR.EXECUTED_BY LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT EXECUTOR_DEPT ON EXECUTOR_DEPT.DEPT_ID = EXECUTOR.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS REGISTRAR ON REGISTRAR.USER_ID = CR.REGISTERED_BY LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT REGISTRAR_DEPT ON REGISTRAR_DEPT.DEPT_ID = REGISTRAR.DEPT_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) AND ORDER BY V.QUERY_ORDER, V.QUERY_ID

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID, H.PREVIOUS_RESULT_STATUS AS "previousResultStatus", H.PREVIOUS_RESULT_NOTE AS "previousResultNote", H.CHANGE_TYPE AS "changeType", H.CHANGE_REASON AS "changeReason", U.USER_NAME AS "changedByName", H.CHANGED_AT AS "changedAt" FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT_HISTORY H JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = H.CHANGED_BY WHERE H.QUERY_ID = #{queryId} ORDER BY H.CHANGED_AT DESC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ID, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.STATUS, A.APPROVER_ID, APPROVER.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME
JOIN APPROVAL A ON A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS APPROVER ON APPROVER.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT APPROVER_DEPT ON APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_ID = APPROVER.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = APPROVER.POSITION_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVER_ID, APPROVER.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, A.STATUS, A.COMMENT_TEXT, A.CREATED_AT, A.DECIDED_AT
JOIN APPROVAL A ON A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS APPROVER ON APPROVER.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT APPROVER_DEPT ON APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_ID = APPROVER.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = APPROVER.POSITION_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT ( QUERY_ID, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_NOTE, EXECUTED_BY, REGISTERED_BY ) SELECT C.QUERY_ID, #{resultStatus}, #{resultNote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{actorId} FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL C JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = C.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND C.QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ('DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN') ) AND ( #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS E JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = E.DEPT_ID WHERE E.USER_ID = #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) )
mapper.select: SELECT CR.RESULT_STATUS FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT CR JOIN DB_CHANGE_SQL C ON C.QUERY_ID = CR.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = C.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND C.QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ('DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN') ) FOR UPDATE OF CR.RESULT_STATUS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT_HISTORY ( QUERY_ID, PREVIOUS_RESULT_STATUS, PREVIOUS_RESULT_NOTE, PREVIOUS_EXECUTED_BY, PREVIOUS_REGISTERED_BY, PREVIOUS_REGISTERED_AT, CHANGE_TYPE, CHANGE_REASON, CHANGED_BY ) SELECT QUERY_ID, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_NOTE, EXECUTED_BY, REGISTERED_BY, REGISTERED_AT, #{changeType}, #{changeReason}, #{actorId} FROM DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE DB_CHANGE_SQL_RESULT SET RESULT_STATUS = #{resultStatus}, RESULT_NOTE = #{resultNote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXECUTED_BY = #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REGISTERED_BY = #{actorId}, REGISTERED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND ( #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS E JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = E.DEPT_ID WHERE E.USER_ID = #{executedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_REQUEST R WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE IN ( 'CREATE_VIEW', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE' ) AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ('DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN') )
